CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  April 28, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman;

  Staff Present: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative;  Steve Kuchenski,
  Secretary/City Architect

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – April 14, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the April 14, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the April 14, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-015
  • 500 North Atlantic Boulevard & 321 West Grand Avenue
  • Applicant: Mary Dorofeyev
  • Request: This is an application for exterior improvements to an
  existing 4-story residential building, consisting of the replacement of

  1
  04/28/2026
   multiple balcony railings, refurbishment of balcony flooring, and
  restoration of balcony guardrail stucco walls.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide a clear note on the plans, legend, and/or elevations
  indicating that the proposed balcony modifications apply
  uniformly to all units.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Recuse: Tsai
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-150
  • 433 South Hidalgo Avenue
  • Applicant: Ronald Ballesteros
  • Request: This is an application for the demolition of an existing 1-
  story residence and the new construction of a 1,679 SF 1-story single-
  family dwelling with an updated exterior design.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Clearly identify on the plans the proposed locations of all
  gutters and downspouts. The color and finish of these
  elements shall be reviewed and approved by City staff.
  2. Revise the window schedule to accurately reflect the window
  types depicted in the elevations. This shall include, but not be
  limited to, revising two (2) Window Type W1 units at the
  northeast corner of the building to single-hung, updating
  Window Type W-5 to single-hung, and clarifying Window Type
  W-7 as operable-fixed-operable.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  2
  04/28/2026
   Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-165
  • 428 North First Street
  • Applicant: Ricky Huang
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations and 303 SF
  addition to an existing 1,252 SF 1-story single-family residence, along
  with associated site improvements.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The project shall incorporate a complementary accent color
  for the window trim, window sills, support brackets, and roof
  fascia. The selected accent color shall be distinct from the
  primary building color palette, which provides a clear visual
  differentiation between the main building components and
  secondary architectural features and details.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The project shall incorporate a complementary accent color
  for the window trim, window sills, support brackets, and roof
  fascia. The selected accent color shall be distinct from the
  primary building color palette, which provides a clear visual
  differentiation between the main building components and
  secondary architectural features and details.
  2. Revise the location of Window Type #9 by shifting it westward
  such that the outer trim aligns with the edge of the gable roof
  above.
  3. Extend the brick veneer along the north elevation to a
  minimum length of five (5) feet. Also, should a side yard fence
  be proposed in the future, it is recommended that the fence
  alignment correspond with the edge of the extended brick
  veneer.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

 E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:48 P.M. to
